content: Live to the point of tears.
author: Albert Camus
story:
Raised in grinding poverty by a widowed, illiterate mother in working-class Algiers and battling chronic tuberculosis throughout his youth, Camus joined the French Resistance in occupied Paris, editing the clandestine newspaper Combat. Refusing both religious dogma and nihilistic despair, Camus championed the 'absurd hero'—one who recognizes the universe's silence yet rebels by living with passionate defiance, integrity, and love.

In formulating this reflection, Albert Camus stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of passion. For Albert Camus, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life are you overthinking the ideal approach instead of taking the simple, honorable action?
